comparison.objective: Tighten a started bracket bolt with short ratchet strokes in confined access.
comparison.physical_skill: Pick up and seat a socket, maintain engagement, alternate drive/return strokes, and transmit controlled rotary torque between walls.
comparison.success_condition: At least 1.8 turns, measured seated contact, six advancing ratchet cycles, socket engagement hold, and no integrity or over-torque fault.
comparison.reason: This is constrained rotary fastening with a one-way clutch. It does not test impact transfer, manufactured-notch fracture, protection of an insert from off-axis blows, or recovery of released fragments.
